title: kbmon's disk alert compares the rounded free_pct, so 9.96% free gives no alert and a 0-byte total gives a false one
goal: mon_host.alerts raises host.disk when the unrounded free share is under 10% and never for a file system that reports a total of 0 bytes; the displayed free_pct keeps one decimal

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import mon_host as m;a=m.alerts({'disk':{'free_pct':round(996*100/10000,1),'free_bytes':996,'total_bytes':10000}});b=m.alerts({'disk':{'free_pct':0.0,'free_bytes':0,'total_bytes':0}});print(a,b);sys.exit(0 if len(a)==1 and b==[] else 1)

import sys, types
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import mon_host as m
m.shutil.disk_usage = lambda r: types.SimpleNamespace(total=10000, used=8766, free=1234)
d = m.disk(".")
assert d["free_pct"] == 12.3 and d["total_bytes"] == 10000 and d["free_bytes"] == 1234, d
